title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
body: Submit expenses within 30 days of purchase through the expense portal with an itemized receipt for anything over $25. Travel: coach airfare, standard hotel, and a $75/day meal per diem for domestic trips are pre-approved without additional sign-off. Client entertainment and anything over $500 requires manager approval before booking. Reimbursements process on the next bi-weekly payroll cycle after approval.
